company.note: Fact groups: license (self-stated or verified), fees (verified, fresh), areas, services, property_types, contact. A profile is indexable only with 3+ groups AND verified fees or a verified license (status active, checked against the state record). Areas, services and contact alone never make a page indexable. Own-site-confirmed companies below that bar but with 2+ groups are listed as noindex,follow. Third-party-directory-only and unverified-lead companies are never generated.

feeComparisonNote: requireStatedServiceArea: true (conservative) means a company's fee rows count toward the fee comparison and the fee-guide gates only when its own site states a Columbus-area service area (a service-areas row). false (liberal) counts every verified fee row. This is the one switch; the build report shows counts under both rules.
